App.title: Muscle atlas & workout book
App.description: Explore muscle regions, movement options and the other muscles involved. An open workout book for planning your training days.
App.fallback: This entry is in English. Help translate it.

intro.title: Choose what to train today.
intro.description: Explore the muscles behind each movement. Start with a training group above, or select a muscle directly on the diagram.

choose.title: Choose a training group
choose.description: Browse chest, back, shoulders, arms, core, or legs to see their individual muscle regions.

explore.title: Find the exact muscle
explore.description: Hover to highlight a region. Select it to open its guide, including deeper muscles available in the list.

learn.title: Understand the movement
learn.description: See exercise options, how to perform them, and which other muscles are involved. Each muscle has its own link to save or share.

intro.community: An open workout book, built together. Suggest corrections, improve translations, or contribute an exercise.

DesignSystem.title: Design system
DesignSystem.intro: Warm graphite, paper-toned type, pencil anatomy, and warm gold interactions. Shared shadcn/ui primitives.
DesignSystem.bodySample: Body copy / 15 px / comfortable line height
DesignSystem.sample: Select a muscle region to explore its exercises.
DesignSystem.interactionBody: Hover previews anatomy. Click toggles the pinned region. Focus uses the same color cues. Keep anatomy unmirrored in right-to-left layouts.
DesignSystem.artworkBody: Use the traced front and back SVG artwork. Keep the pencil linework visible beneath translucent muscle highlights.
DesignSystem.textureBody: A light paper grain adds warmth to dark surfaces. Keep controls and text crisp; reserve hand-drawn detail for the anatomy.
